lessons.name: Nol va bir
lessons.goal: Bola 0 va 1 raqamini taniydi, shaklini eslab qoladi, bitta narsani sanaydi
lessons.intro: Salom, do'stim! Men — robot Kabu. Bip-bip! Bugun biz Raqamlar mamlakatiga sayohat qilamiz. U yerda har bir raqam — tirik qahramon! Birinchi bo'lib ikki do'st kutib turibdi. Ular kim ekan?

items.image_prompt: A round white egg shaped like the digit zero with a smiling face, empty basket nearby, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — nol raqami. Qara, u xuddi yumaloq tuxumga o'xshaydi 🥚! Savatda birorta ham olma qolmasa, biz «nol» deymiz — hech narsa yo'q. Havoda barmog'ing bilan katta doira chiz — mana, nol!

items.image_prompt: One tall red pencil standing like the digit one with a small nose, one apple beside, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — bir raqami. U tik turgan askarga o'xshaydi: to'g'ri, ingichka, tepasida kichkina burni bor 📏. Bitta quyosh ☀️, bitta burun 👃 — hammasi bir! Barmog'ingni tik ko'tarib ko'rsat.

tests.q: Savatda hech narsa yo'q 🧺. Nechta olma bor?
tests.why: To'g'ri! Hech narsa yo'q — bu nol.

tests.q: Qaysi raqam tik turgan askarga o'xshaydi? 💂
tests.why: Zo'r! Bir — to'g'ri, tik turgan askar.

extra.matn: Qani, birga kuylaymiz! «Nol — yumaloq tuxumcha, ichida hech narsa yo'q. Bir — tik turgan askarcha, burni tepaga qarab turibdi!» Endi nol deganda qo'ling bilan doira yasa, bir deganda tik tur!

lessons.name: Ikki va uch
lessons.goal: Bola 2 va 3 raqamlarini shaklidan taniydi va narsalarni uchgacha sanaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Kecha nol va bir bilan tanishdik. Bugun Raqamlar mamlakatining ko'lida ikki mehmon suzib yuribdi. Biri — oqqush, ikkinchisi — nimaga o'xshaydi? Qani, ko'ramiz!

items.image_prompt: A white swan on a lake shaped like the digit two, two ducklings, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — ikki raqami. U ko'lda suzayotgan oqqushga o'xshaydi 🦢: tepada egilgan bo'yni, pastda tekis qorni. Bizda ikkita ko'z 👀, ikkita qo'l bor. Ikkita barmoqni ko'rsat!

items.image_prompt: Digit three drawn like two round bellies of a snowman sideways, three balloons, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — uch raqami. Qara, u yon tomondan ikki qorinchali qordonga o'xshaydi ⛄ — tepada bitta yarim doira, pastda yana bitta. Svetoforda uchta chiroq bor 🚦: qizil, sariq, yashil. Uchta barmoqni ko'rsat!

tests.q: Ko'lda oqqush suzyapti 🦢. Qaysi raqam oqqushga o'xshaydi?

tests.why: Zo'r! Bir, ikki, uch — uchta shar.

extra.matn: Men «ikki» desam — oqqushdek qo'llaringni qanot qilib suz. «Uch» desam — qordondek dumaloq bo'lib tur. «Bir» desam — askardek tik tur! Tayyormisan? Ikki! Uch! Bir! Uch! Barakalla!

lessons.name: To'rt va besh
lessons.goal: Bola 4 va 5 raqamlarini taniydi, beshtagacha sanaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Raqamlar mamlakatida bir uycha bor. Uning oldida ag'darilgan stulcha yotibdi, eshik oldida esa shlyapali qorinchali bir bola turibdi. Ular — to'rt va besh raqamlari! Qani, tanishamiz.

items.image_prompt: Digit four looking like an upside-down chair, a cat with four paws, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — to'rt raqami. U oyog'i tepaga qaragan ag'darilgan stulchaga o'xshaydi 🪑. Mushukning to'rtta oyog'i bor 🐈, stolning ham to'rtta oyog'i bor. To'rtta barmoqni ko'rsat!

items.image_prompt: Digit five as a chubby boy with a flat hat, an open hand with five fingers, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — besh raqami. U tepasida tekis shlyapa kiygan, qorni dumaloq bolaga o'xshaydi 🎩. Bir qo'limizda beshta barmoq bor ✋. Qo'lingni och va sana: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh!

extra.matn: Qo'lingni ko'tar va har barmoqni bukib kuyla: «Bir — katta barmoq, ikki — ko'rsatkich, uch — o'rtancha, to'rt — nomsiz, besh — jimjiloq! Beshta barmoq — bir qo'l, qarsak chalib o'ynaymiz!» Endi qarsak chal: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh!

lessons.name: Beshgacha sanaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola 0 dan 5 gacha sanaydi, sonni narsalar soni bilan moslaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Nol, bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh — hammasi yig'ilishdi! Ular saf tortib turishibdi. Lekin bitta sir bor: to'g'ri sanash uchun maxsus qoida bor ekan. Qanday qoida? Hozir bilamiz!

items.image_prompt: A child finger pointing at apples one by one while counting, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sanayotganda har bir narsani barmoq bilan bir marta ko'rsatamiz 👉. Birorta ham narsani tashlab ketmaymiz, ikki marta ham sanamaymiz. Oxirgi aytgan sonimiz — hammasi nechta ekanini bildiradi. Masalan: 🍎🍎🍎 — bir, ikki, uch. Uchta olma!

items.image_prompt: Digits zero to five standing in a line like friends holding hands, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Raqamlar doim bir tartibda saf tortadi: nol, bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh. Har bir keyingi raqam bittaga ko'p. Qadam tashlab sana: har qadamda bitta son!

tests.why: To'g'ri! Bir, ikki, uch, to'rt — to'rtta baliq.

tests.q: Qatorda 2 dan keyin qaysi raqam turadi?
tests.why: Ofarin! Bir, ikki, uch — 2 dan keyin 3.

extra.matn: Men raqam aytaman, sen shuncha marta qarsak chalasan! Uch — 👏👏👏. To'rt! Bir! Besh! Nol — hech qarsak chalmaymiz, jim turamiz! Qoyil, sen haqiqiy sanoq ustasisan!

lessons.name: Olti va yetti
lessons.goal: Bola 6 va 7 raqamlarini shaklidan taniydi va yettigacha sanaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Raqamlar mamlakatida bog' bor. Bog'da bir salyangoz o'rmalab yuribdi, yonida esa egilgan chiroq ustuni turibdi. Bilasanmi, ular ham raqamlar! Kim ekan?

items.image_prompt: A snail with round shell shaped like digit six, six ladybugs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — olti raqami. U salyangozga o'xshaydi 🐌: pastda dumaloq uychasi, tepaga esa boshini cho'zib turibdi. Besh barmoq va yana bitta barmoq — olti bo'ladi. Qara: ✋☝️ — oltita!
items.action: Besh va yana bitta barmoqni ko'rsat!

items.image_prompt: A bent street lamp shaped like digit seven, seven colors of rainbow, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — yetti raqami. U boshini egib turgan ko'cha chirog'iga o'xshaydi 🏮: tepada ko'ndalang chiziq, pastga qiyshiq ustun. Kamalakda yettita rang bor 🌈. Haftada ham yetti kun bor!

tests.q: Qaysi raqam egilgan chiroq ustuniga o'xshaydi? 🏮

extra.matn: Men «olti» desam — salyangozdek cho'nqayib, boshingni ko'tar. «Yetti» desam — chiroqdek tik turib, boshingni egib qo'y. Olti! Yetti! Olti! Endi sekin sanaymiz: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh, olti, yetti — va qarsak!

lessons.name: Sakkiz va to'qqiz
lessons.goal: Bola 8 va 9 raqamlarini taniydi, 6 va 9 ni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Qish keldi, Raqamlar mamlakatiga qor yog'di. Bolalar ikki dumaloq qor koptokdan qordon yasashdi. Yonida esa ipli sharcha uchib yuribdi. Bular — sakkiz va to'qqiz!

items.image_prompt: A snowman made of two round snowballs shaped like digit eight, octopus, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — sakkiz raqami. U ikki dumaloq qor koptokdan yasalgan qordonga o'xshaydi ⛄: tepada kichik halqa, pastda katta halqa. Sakkizoyoqning sakkizta oyog'i bor 🐙. Havoda sakkiz chiz — to'xtamasdan aylantir!

items.image_prompt: A balloon on a string shaped like digit nine, nine small stars, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — to'qqiz raqami. U ipga bog'langan sharchaga o'xshaydi 🎈: tepada dumaloq shar, pastga ip tushib turibdi. Oltini teskari ag'darsak — to'qqiz bo'ladi! Olti salyangozdek pastda dumaloq, to'qqiz esa tepada dumaloq.

tests.q: Qaysi raqamning dumalog'i tepada, ipi pastda? 🎈

extra.matn: Qog'ozga 6 raqamini yoz va uni teskari aylantir — nima bo'ldi? To'qqiz! Salyangoz sharchaga aylandi. Esda tut: dumalog'i pastda — olti, dumalog'i tepada — to'qqiz.

lessons.name: O'n soni
lessons.goal: Bola 10 ni ikki raqamdan (1 va 0) iborat son sifatida taniydi, o'ntagacha sanaydi

items.image_prompt: Ten colorful balloons in a row with digits one to ten, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square

tests.why: Barakalla! Oldin bir, keyin nol — o'n.

extra.matn: Kuylaymiz va barmoqni bittadan ochamiz: «Bir, ikki — qo'l ko'tar, uch, to'rt — qarsak chal, besh, olti — sakrang bir bor, yetti, sakkiz — aylaning, to'qqiz, o'n — ta'zim qil, sanoqni yaxshi bilamiz!»

lessons.name: Ko'p, kam, teng

items.image_prompt: A basket full of five red apples next to a basket with two apples, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square

items.image_prompt: Two plates each with three cookies, balanced scale, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square

lessons.name: O'ndan orqaga

lessons.name: Shar va kub
lessons.goal: Bola shar va kub shakllarini taniydi, ularning farqini aytadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Men o'yinchoqlar qutisini ochdim. Ichida to'p va kubik bor. To'p nega dumalab ketadi-yu, kubik joyida turadi? Bu sirni birga ochamiz!

items.image_prompt: A colorful ball rolling on the floor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — shar. Uning hech qayerida burchak ham, tekis joy ham yo'q — hamma tomoni dumaloq. Shuning uchun shar oson dumalaydi ⚽. Koptok, tarvuz 🍉, Yer shari 🌍 — hammasi sharga o'xshaydi.

items.image_prompt: A wooden toy cube with letters, a sugar cube, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — kub. Uning oltita tekis yuzi bor, har bir yuzi — kvadrat. Kubning burchaklari bor, shuning uchun u dumalamaydi, joyida turadi 🧊. O'yinchoq kubik, qand, muz bo'lagi — kubga o'xshaydi.

extra.matn: Stol ustiga koptok va o'yinchoq kubikni qo'y. Ikkalasini ham barmoq bilan sekin itar. Nima bo'ldi? Koptok dumalab ketdi, kubik esa sal siljidi-yu, to'xtadi. Chunki sharda burchak yo'q, kubda esa bor!

lessons.name: Silindr va konus
lessons.goal: Bola silindr va konus shakllarini taniydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Oshxonaga qara: stakan, banka... Ko'chaga qara: yo'l konusi, bayram qalpoqchasi... Bular ham shakllar ekan! Bugun ikki yangi shakl bilan tanishamiz.

items.uz: ikki tomoni tekis doira, yoni dumaloq
items.image_prompt: A tin can standing, a round pencil, a glass, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — silindr. Uning tepasida va pastida tekis doira bor, yon tomoni esa dumaloq. Tik qo'ysak — turadi, yotqizsak — dumalaydi! Banka 🥫, stakan, qalam silindrga o'xshaydi.

items.image_prompt: An ice cream cone, an orange traffic cone, a party hat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — konus. Uning pastida tekis doira bor, tepasi esa uchli bo'lib tugaydi. Muzqaymoq voronkasi 🍦, yo'l konusi, bayram qalpoqchasi 🥳 — hammasi konus!
items.action: Qo'llaringni boshing ustida uchli qilib birlashtir!

tests.q: Qaysi shaklning ikki tomoni tekis doira?
tests.why: Zo'r! Silindrning tepasi ham, pasti ham doira.

extra.matn: Sen sotuvchisan, men xaridor! Men aytaman: «Menga tepasi uchli narsa ber!» — sen konusni topasan. «Menga yotqizsa dumalaydigan, tik qo'ysa turadigan narsa ber!» — silindr! «Hamma tomoni dumaloq narsa!» — shar! Rahmat, sotuvchi!

lessons.name: Dumalaydi yoki turadi
lessons.goal: Bola shakllarni xossasiga ko'ra ajratadi: dumalaydi, turadi, ikkalasi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Shakllar poyga o'tkazmoqchi! Ammo kim dumalab poygaga chiqa oladi, kim joyida qoladi? Qiya taxtachaga qo'yib ko'ramiz. Taxmining qanday?

items.image_prompt: A ball and a lying can rolling down a wooden slope, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Dumaloq yuzli shakllar dumalaydi. Shar har tomonga dumalaydi ⚽. Silindrni yotqizsak — u ham to'g'riga dumalaydi 🥫. Konus esa aylanib-aylanib dumalaydi.

items.image_prompt: A toy cube and a standing can staying still on a slope, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Tekis yuzli shakllar joyida turadi. Kubni qanday qo'ysang ham — turadi 🧊. Silindrni tik qo'ysak — u ham turadi. Shuning uchun uylar kubga o'xshash g'ishtdan quriladi 🧱!

tests.q: Qaysi shakl ham turadi, ham dumalaydi?
tests.why: Barakalla! Silindr tik tursa turadi, yotsa dumalaydi.
Zo'r! G'isht quti kabi tekis — turadi.

extra.matn: Kitobni bir tomonidan ko'tarib, qiya taxta yasa. Uning ustiga koptok, kubik, qalam va muzqaymoq voronkasini (yoki qog'oz konusni) qo'y. Qaysilari pastga tushdi? Qaysi biri qoldi? Ota-onangga natijani aytib ber!

lessons.name: Shakllar atrofimizda
lessons.goal: Bola atrofidagi narsalarda shar, kub, silindr, konusni topadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Bugun biz izquvar bo'lamiz! Uyda, ko'chada, bog'chada yashirinib olgan shakllarni topamiz. Lupani ol — qidiruvni boshladik!

items.image_prompt: A cozy room with a ball, a gift box, a glass and a party hat, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uyda shakllar ko'p! Koptok — shar ⚽. Sovg'a qutisi — kub 🎁. Stakan — silindr 🥛. Bayram qalpoqchasi — konus 🥳. Xonangga qara: yana nimalar bor?

items.image_prompt: A toy castle built from cubes, cylinders towers and cone roofs, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Shakllardan qasr quramiz 🏰! Pastiga kublar qo'yamiz — ular mustahkam turadi. Minoralar uchun silindr, minoralar tepasiga esa konus — tom bo'ladi. Shar esa qasr oldida koptok bo'lib o'ynaydi!

tests.q: Qasr minorasining tepasiga qaysi shakl mos? 🏰

lessons.name: Haftaning boshlanishi
lessons.goal: Bola hafta 7 kundan iboratligini biladi, dushanba, seshanba, chorshanbani aytadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Bilasanmi, kunlar ham oila bo'lib yashaydi! Ularning oilasi — hafta. Oilada nechta aka-uka bor ekan? Bugun birinchi uchtasi bilan tanishamiz.

items.image_prompt: A calendar page with seven colorful day boxes, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Hafta — bu yetti kun. Yetti kun o'tgach, hafta qaytadan boshlanadi. Esingdami, kamalakda ham yetti rang bor edi 🌈? Haftada ham yetti kun!

items.image_prompt: A cheerful sun waking up, children going to kindergarten, badge with number one, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Dushanba — haftaning birinchi kuni. Dam olishdan keyin bog'chaga, ota-onalar ishga boradi. «Dush» — birinchi kun deb esla!

items.image_prompt: Two calendar pages with numbers two and three and happy faces, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Seshanba — ikkinchi kun, chorshanba — uchinchi kun. Tartibni esla: dushanba, seshanba, chorshanba. Sanoqqa o'xshaydi: bir, ikki, uch!

extra.matn: Hafta — poyezd, kunlar — vagonlar! «Chuh-chuh! Birinchi vagon — dushanba, ikkinchisi — seshanba, uchinchisi — chorshanba!» Bir-biringning yelkangdan ushlab, poyezd bo'lib yur va vagonlarni sana!

lessons.name: Payshanbadan yakshanbagacha
lessons.goal: Bola haftaning barcha 7 kunini tartib bilan aytadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Kunlar poyezdiga yana to'rtta vagon ulanishi kerak. Ular kim ekan? Ulardan ikkitasi — eng sevimli kunlar, chunki dam olamiz! Qaysilari ekan?

items.image_prompt: Two calendar pages with numbers four and five, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Payshanba — to'rtinchi kun, juma — beshinchi kun. Jumada ish haftasi tugaydi. Tartib: chorshanba, payshanba, juma.

items.image_prompt: A family having a picnic in the park on a sunny weekend, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Shanba — oltinchi kun, yakshanba — yettinchi, oxirgi kun. Ko'pchilik bu kunlari dam oladi 🧺: sayrga chiqamiz, mehmonga boramiz. Yakshanbadan keyin yana dushanba keladi!

items.image_prompt: A toy train with seven colorful wagons, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Endi butun haftani aytamiz: dushanba, seshanba, chorshanba, payshanba, juma, shanba, yakshanba! Har bir kun uchun bitta barmoq buk — yettita bo'ldi!

lessons.name: To'rt fasl
lessons.goal: Bola to'rt faslni nomlaydi va belgilarini aytadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Men qushchaman, yil bo'yi tabiatni kuzataman. Goh qor yog'adi, goh gul ochiladi, goh issiq bo'ladi, goh barglar to'kiladi. Bu o'zgarishlar — fasllar! Nechta ekan?

items.image_prompt: Snowy landscape with a snowman and children in warm hats, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qish — eng sovuq fasl. Qor yog'adi ❄️, qordon yasaymiz, chana uchamiz. Issiq kiyim, qalpoq va qo'lqop kiyamiz 🧤.

items.image_prompt: Blooming trees, tulips and returning swallows, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bahor — uyg'onish fasli. Qor eriydi, daraxtlar gullaydi 🌸, qushlar qaytib keladi. Navro'z bayrami bahorda keladi!

items.image_prompt: Bright sun, children swimming, watermelon and cherries, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yoz — eng issiq fasl. Quyosh charaqlaydi ☀️, suvda cho'milamiz. Tarvuz, olcha, uzum pishadi 🍉.

items.image_prompt: Trees with yellow and orange falling leaves, apples, rain, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kuz — hosil fasli. Barglar sarg'ayib to'kiladi 🍂, yomg'ir yog'adi. Olma, anor, paxta terib olinadi. Kuzda bolalar maktabga boradi!

tests.why: Zo'r! Qish, bahor, yoz, kuz — to'rtta.

extra.matn: Men fasl aytaman — sen ko'rsatasan! Qish — qaltirab, qo'llarni ishqala. Bahor — gul bo'lib, qo'llarni ochib o's. Yoz — suzgandek qo'l silta. Kuz — barg bo'lib, aylanib yerga tush! Qish! Yoz! Kuz! Bahor!

lessons.name: Kecha, bugun, ertaga
lessons.goal: Bola fasllar ketma-ketligini va kecha-bugun-ertaga tushunchalarini biladi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Fasllar ham, kunlar ham doira bo'lib aylanadi — biri ketadi, boshqasi keladi. Bugun vaqt g'ildiragini aylantiramiz. Qaysi fasl qaysidan keyin keladi?

items.image_prompt: A circle divided into four parts showing winter, spring, summer, autumn, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Fasllar doim bir tartibda keladi: qishdan keyin bahor, bahordan keyin yoz, yozdan keyin kuz, kuzdan keyin yana qish ❄️🌷☀️🍂. Xuddi aylanib turuvchi g'ildirakdek!

items.image_prompt: A calendar page with a big red circle around one day, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bugun — biz hozir yashayotgan kun. Bugun nima qilding? Bog'chaga keldingmi, o'ynadingmi? Hammasi — bugun!

items.image_prompt: Three calendar pages: a crossed-out one, a circled one, and one with a star, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kecha — bugundan oldingi, o'tib ketgan kun ⬅️. Ertaga — bugundan keyin keladigan kun ➡️. Agar bugun seshanba bo'lsa, kecha dushanba edi, ertaga esa chorshanba bo'ladi!

tests.q: Bugun juma. Kecha qaysi kun edi?

extra.matn: robot Kabu so'raydi: «Kecha nima qilding?» Sen javob ber: «Kecha men ... o'ynadim». «Bugun-chi?» — «Bugun men ... ». «Ertaga nima qilasan?» — «Ertaga men ... qilaman». Ota-onang bilan ham shunday suhbatlash!

lessons.name: Uzun va qisqa
lessons.goal: Bola ikki narsani uzunligi bo'yicha solishtiradi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Ikki ilon do'st bo'lib qolishdi. Biri: «Men uzunman!» deydi, ikkinchisi: «Men-chi?» deydi. Qanday bilamiz, kim uzun? Ularni yonma-yon yotqizamiz!

items.image_prompt: A very long green snake next to a short one, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ikki narsani yonma-yon qo'yamiz — boshlari bir joyda bo'lsin. Qaysi biri uzoqroqqa cho'zilsa — o'sha uzun. Uzun ilon 🐍, uzun poyezd 🚂, uzun sharf 🧣.

items.image_prompt: A short stubby pencil next to a long new pencil, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yonma-yon qo'yganda oldinroq tugaydigan narsa — qisqa. Ishlatilib kichrayib qolgan qalam — qisqa ✏️. Qisqa arqoncha, qisqa quyruq 🐇.

items.image_prompt: Two ribbons laid side by side starting at the same line, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: To'g'ri solishtirish uchun ikki narsaning boshini bir chiziqqa qo'yamiz. Aks holda, ko'zimiz aldanishi mumkin! Boshlar teng — endi uchlariga qaraymiz.

tests.q: Qaysi biri qisqa: yangi qalam yoki ishlatilgan kichkina qalam? ✏️
Ikki tasmani to'g'ri solishtirish uchun nima qilamiz?

lessons.name: Qadam bilan o'lchaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola masofani qadam bilan o'lchaydi va sanaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Xonadagi eshikdan derazagacha qancha yo'l bor? Bizda chizg'ich yo'q. Lekin oyoqlarimiz bor! Qani, qadam bilan o'lchaymiz — bu juda qiziq!

items.image_prompt: Child footprints in a row on the floor, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: O'lchash — bu nechta bir xil bo'lak sig'ishini sanash. Qadam tashlaymiz va sanaymiz: bir qadam, ikki qadam, uch qadam 👣. Eshikdan stolgacha nechta qadam bo'lsa — masofa shuncha!

items.uz: qadam soni katta bo'lsa, yo'l uzun
items.image_prompt: A long path with many footprints and a short path with few, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Agar bir yo'lga sakkiz qadam, boshqasiga uch qadam ketgan bo'lsa — sakkiz qadamli yo'l uzoqroq. Ko'p qadam — uzoq, kam qadam — yaqin!

items.image_prompt: A big elephant footprint and small mouse footprints, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Dadamning qadami katta, meniki kichik. Shuning uchun bir yo'lni dadam 4 qadamda, men 7 qadamda o'tdim 🐘🐭. To'g'ri o'lchash uchun bitta odam, bir xil qadam bilan o'lchashi kerak.

tests.q: Eshikkacha 5 qadam, derazagacha 8 qadam. Qaysi biri uzoq?
Fil 🐘 va sichqon 🐭 bir yo'lni o'tdi. Kim ko'p qadam tashlaydi?
tests.why: Ofarin! Sichqonning qadami kichik — ko'p qadam kerak.

extra.matn: Ota-onang bilan uyda o'lcha: oshxonadan yotoqxonagacha nechta qadam? Eshikdan divangacha-chi? Keyin dadang ham o'lchasin. Kimniki ko'p chiqdi? Nega? Chunki sening qadaming kichik!

lessons.name: Qarich va ip bilan
lessons.goal: Bola narsalarni qarich va ip (chiziq) bilan o'lchaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Stol qancha uzun? Qadam bilan o'lchab bo'lmaydi — stol ustida yurmaymiz-ku! Unda qo'limiz va bir bo'lak ip yordamga keladi.

items.image_prompt: A child's hand stretched out measuring a table edge, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kaftni keng oching 🖐️: bosh barmoq bilan jimjiloq orasi — bu bir qarich. Stolga qarichni qo'yib, ketma-ket o'lchaymiz: bir, ikki, uch qarich. Stol necha qarich ekan?

items.image_prompt: A red string stretched along a book and a pencil, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Egri narsani qanday o'lchaymiz? Ipni uning bo'ylab qo'yamiz, keyin ipni to'g'rilab, boshqa narsa bilan solishtiramiz 🧵. Uzun ip — uzun narsa!

items.image_prompt: Two straight colored lines drawn on paper, one long one short, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qog'ozga qalam bilan chiziq chizamiz. Qalamni uzoq yurgizsak — uzun chiziq, ozgina yurgizsak — qisqa chiziq ✏️. Chiziqlarni ham boshini tenglab solishtiramiz.

tests.q: Bosh barmoq va jimjiloq orasi nima deyiladi? 🖐️
Stol 6 qarich, kursi 3 qarich. Qaysi biri uzun?
Egri yo'lni nima bilan o'lchash qulay?
Kitob 🖐️🖐️ ikki qarich, daftar 🖐️ bir qarich. Qaysi biri qisqa?

lessons.name: Og'ir va yengil
lessons.goal: Bola narsalarni og'irligi bo'yicha solishtiradi, tarozi ishini tushunadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Men patchaman — juda yengilman, shamol meni uchirib ketadi! Filning esa og'irligi shunchalik ko'pki, uni hech kim ko'tarolmaydi. Og'ir va yengil — nima ekan?

items.image_prompt: A child trying to lift a big heavy watermelon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Og'ir narsani ko'tarish qiyin, u qo'lni pastga tortadi. Tarvuz 🍉, g'isht 🧱, fil 🐘 — og'ir. Katta chelak suv ham og'ir!

items.image_prompt: A feather and a balloon floating in the air, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yengil narsani ko'tarish oson. Pat 🪶, shar 🎈, qog'oz — yengil. Ularni hatto shamol ham uchirib ketadi!

items.image_prompt: A balance scale with a watermelon going down and an apple going up, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Tarozining ikki pallasi bor ⚖️. Og'ir narsa qo'yilgan palla pastga tushadi, yengil narsa pallasi tepaga ko'tariladi. Agar ikkalasi bir xil og'ir bo'lsa — tarozi teng turadi.

tests.q: Tarozining bir pallasi pastga tushdi. U yerdagi narsa qanday?

extra.matn: Ikki qo'lingni tarozi pallasidek oldinga cho'z. Bir qo'lga olma, ikkinchisiga yong'oq qo'y. Qaysi qo'l pastga tortyapti? O'sha narsa og'ir! Endi kitob va qalamni solishtir. Ota-onangga natijani aytib ber!

lessons.name: Labirint
lessons.goal: Bola labirintdan chiqish yo'lini topadi, o'ng va chapni farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Kichkina sichqoncha pishloq hidini sezdi, lekin ular orasida chalkash yo'llar — labirint bor! Unga yo'l topishga yordam beramizmi?

items.image_prompt: A cute mouse at the entrance of a simple garden maze with cheese at the exit, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Labirint — ko'p burilishli yo'llar. Ba'zi yo'llar devorga taqalib qoladi — bu berk yo'l. Barmog'imiz bilan yo'lni kuzatamiz; berk yo'lga kirsak, orqaga qaytib boshqasini sinaymiz 🐭🧀.

items.image_prompt: A child raising right hand, arrow pointing right, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: O'ng qo'lingni ko'tar — bu o'ng tomon 👉. Ko'pchilik o'ng qo'l bilan qoshiq ushlaydi. Labirintda «o'ngga burilamiz» desak — o'ng qo'l tomonga ketamiz.

items.image_prompt: A child raising left hand, arrow pointing left, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Chap qo'lingni ko'tar — bu chap tomon 👈. Yuragimiz chap tomonda uradi ❤️. «Chapga burilamiz» desak — chap qo'l tomonga ketamiz.

tests.q: Labirintda yo'l devorga taqaldi. Nima qilamiz?
tests.why: To'g'ri! Orqaga qaytib, boshqa yo'lni sinaymiz.

extra.matn: Sen — robot, men — boshqaruvchi! «Ikki qadam oldinga! O'ngga buril! Bir qadam oldinga! Chapga buril! To'xta!» Robot faqat buyruq bilan yuradi. Endi sen buyruq ber, ota-onang robot bo'lsin!

lessons.name: Strelkalar yo'li
lessons.goal: Bola strelkalar bo'yicha yo'lni kuzatadi: yuqoriga, pastga, o'ngga, chapga
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Men xazina xaritasini topdim! Unda so'z yo'q, faqat strelkalar chizilgan. Strelkalar ko'rsatgan tomonga yursak — xazinani topamiz! Qani, ketdik!

items.image_prompt: A child pointing up at a bird and down at a flower, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yuqoriga — tepaga, osmon tomonga ⬆️. Pastga — yer tomonga ⬇️. Qushlar yuqorida uchadi, gullar pastda o'sadi. Qo'lingni yuqoriga ko'tar, endi pastga tushir!

items.image_prompt: Colorful arrows pointing in four directions on a treasure map, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Strelka qaysi tomonga qarasa, o'sha tomonga yuramiz. ➡️ — o'ngga, ⬅️ — chapga, ⬆️ — yuqoriga, ⬇️ — pastga. Har bir strelka — bitta qadam!

items.image_prompt: A treasure map with a dotted path made of arrows leading to a chest, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Xaritada strelkalar qatori: ➡️➡️⬆️. Demak: ikki qadam o'ngga, bir qadam yuqoriga. Har strelkani barmoq bilan ko'rsatib, sanab boramiz — adashmaymiz! 🏴‍☠️

extra.matn: Ota-onang xonada o'yinchoqni yashirsin va qog'ozga strelkalar chizsin: ⬆️⬆️⬆️ ➡️➡️. Sen strelkalar bo'yicha qadam tashlaysan: uch qadam oldinga, ikki qadam o'ngga. Xazinani topdingmi? Barakalla, kapitan!

lessons.name: Ortiqchasini top
lessons.goal: Bola guruhdagi boshqalarga o'xshamaydigan narsani topadi va sababini aytadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Mevalar savatiga kimdir ayyorlik qilib bir narsa tashlab ketibdi. U mevalarga o'xshamaydi! Ortiqcha mehmonni topamiz va nega ortiqcha ekanini aytamiz.

items.image_prompt: A basket with an apple, a pear, a banana and a grape, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Guruh — bir-biriga o'xshash narsalar. Olma, nok, banan — mevalar guruhi 🍎🍐🍌. Shar, kub, konus — shakllar guruhi. Nimasi o'xshashligini topamiz: rangi, shakli yoki turi.

items.image_prompt: A basket of fruits with a toy car inside looking out of place, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ortiqcha — guruhga o'xshamaydigan narsa. 🍎🍐🍌🚗 — mashina ortiqcha, chunki u meva emas! Ortiqchani topgach, har doim «nega?» degan savolga javob beramiz.

tests.why: Ofarin! Kub dumaloq emas, qolganlari sharga o'xshaydi.

extra.matn: Men uchta so'z aytaman — qaysi biri ortiqcha va nega? «Qish, yoz, dushanba» — dushanba, chunki u fasl emas, kun! «Uch, besh, olma» — olma, chunki u son emas! Endi sen menga topishmoq tuz!

lessons.name: Mantiqiy qatorlar

Shoxda 10 ta qush bor edi. 4 tasi uchib ketdi. Nechta qoldi?

extra.matn: Men sotuvchi, sen xaridorsan. Peshtaxtada 7 ta olma bor. Sen 2 tasini sotib olding. Peshtaxtada nechta qoldi? Beshta! Endi sen sotuvchi bo'l: nechta meva bor, nechtasini sotding, nechtasi qoldi — o'zing aytib ber!

lessons.name: Masalani o'zimiz tuzamiz
lessons.goal: Bola rasm bo'yicha qo'shish va ayirishga masala tuzadi va yechadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Endi sen o'qituvchi bo'lasan! Men rasm ko'rsataman, sen esa unga hikoya-masala o'ylab topasan. Ota-onang yechsin — sen tekshirasan!

items.uz: rasmga qarab shart va savol tuzish
items.image_prompt: A pond with four ducks and two more ducks landing, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Rasmga qara: ko'lda 4 ta o'rdak 🦆, yana 2 tasi uchib kelyapti. Masala tuzamiz: «Ko'lda 4 ta o'rdak bor edi. Yana 2 tasi uchib keldi. Nechta bo'ldi?» Shart bor, savol bor — masala tayyor!

items.image_prompt: A child thinking with a thought bubble showing 3 plus 2 and toy bears, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Misol berilsa ham masala tuzsa bo'ladi! 7 − 3: «Qutida 7 ta ayiqcha bor edi. 3 tasini dugonamga berdim. Nechtasi qoldi?» Har bir misol ichida hikoya yashiringan.

items.image_prompt: A magnifying glass over counting dots, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Javob topgach, tekshiramiz: rasmni qaytadan sanaymiz 🔍. Qo'shishda javob katta songa, ayirishda kichik songa o'xshashi kerak. To'g'ri chiqsa — barakalla!

tests.q: Ko'lda 🦆🦆🦆🦆, yana 🦆🦆 uchib keldi. Qaysi misol mos?
«Qutida 7 ayiqcha bor edi, 3 tasini berdim.» Qaysi misol?
5 + 3 = ? Masalaga javob ber: «5 ta olma bor edi, 3 ta keldi.»

extra.matn: Kechki ovqatda oilang uchun masala tuz! Masalan: «Dasturxonda 4 ta non bor edi. Dadam yana 2 ta non olib keldi. Nechta bo'ldi?» Kim to'g'ri javob bersa — unga yulduzcha chizing ⭐. Kim ko'p yulduz yig'adi?

lessons.name: Uchburchak va to'rtburchak
lessons.goal: Bola uchburchak, kvadrat va to'g'ri to'rtburchakni burchak va tomonlarini sanab taniydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Men uy chizdim: pastda devor, tepada tom. Devor qanday shakl? Tom-chi? Ularning burchaklarini sanab, nomini topamiz!

items.image_prompt: A house roof shaped as a triangle, a slice of watermelon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Uchburchakning uchta burchagi va uchta tomoni bor 🔺. Burchaklarni barmoq bilan sana: bir, ikki, uch! Uy tomi, tarvuz tilimi, yo'l belgisi uchburchakka o'xshaydi.

items.image_prompt: A red square window with four equal sides, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kvadratning to'rtta burchagi va to'rtta tomoni bor, hamma tomonlari teng 🟥. Esingdami, kubning yuzlari kvadrat edi! Shaxmat katagi ham kvadrat.

items.image_prompt: A wooden door and a book shaped as rectangles, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: To'g'ri to'rtburchakning ham to'rtta burchagi bor, lekin ikki tomoni uzun, ikkitasi qisqa ▭. Eshik 🚪, kitob, telefon — to'g'ri to'rtburchak.

tests.q: Hamma tomoni teng, 4 burchakli shakl qaysi?

extra.matn: Oltita cho'p yoki qalam ol. Uchtasidan uchburchak yasang 🔺. To'rttasidan kvadrat yasang 🟥. Endi ikkita uzun va ikkita qisqa qalamdan to'g'ri to'rtburchak yasa! Nechta cho'p ishlatding? Sana!

lessons.name: Ko'pburchaklar
lessons.goal: Bola ko'pburchak tushunchasini, beshburchak va oltiburchakni biladi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Ari uyasiga qarasang, kataklari qiziq shaklda — oltita burchakli! Burchaklari ko'p shakllar «ko'pburchaklar» deyiladi. Qani, sanaymiz!

items.image_prompt: A shape with corners highlighted by red dots and sides by blue lines, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Burchak — ikki chiziq uchrashgan uchli joy. Tomon — ikki burchak orasidagi to'g'ri chiziq. Har bir ko'pburchakda burchaklar soni tomonlar soniga teng!

items.image_prompt: A simple house shape pentagon, soccer ball patches, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Beshburchakning beshta burchagi va beshta tomoni bor ⬟. Kvadrat ustiga uchburchak tom qo'ysak — uycha-beshburchak bo'ladi! Burchaklarni sana: bir, ikki, uch, to'rt, besh.

items.image_prompt: Honeycomb cells with bees, hexagon shapes, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Oltiburchakning oltita burchagi va oltita tomoni bor ⬡. Asalarilar uyasining kataklari oltiburchak 🐝🍯. Doira doira-da, uning burchagi yo'q — u ko'pburchak emas!

extra.matn: Xonada qidir: nechta to'rtburchak topasan? Deraza, eshik, kitob, televizor... Uchburchak-chi? Oltiburchak topsang — sen super-ovchisan! Topganingning burchaklarini barmoq bilan sanab ko'rsat.

lessons.name: Teng yarim
lessons.goal: Bola shaklni ikkita teng bo'lakka bo'ladi, «yarim» tushunchasini biladi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Ikki do'st bitta olma topishdi. Ikkalasi ham xafa bo'lmasligi uchun olmani qanday bo'lish kerak? Adolatli bo'lish sirini bilib olamiz!

items.image_prompt: An apple cut into two identical halves, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Teng bo'lish — bo'laklar bir xil katta bo'lishi. Agar bir bo'lak katta, biri kichik bo'lsa — teng emas, adolatsiz! Bo'laklarni ustma-ust qo'ysak, ular bir-birini to'la yopishi kerak.

items.image_prompt: A round cookie broken into two equal halves, one half highlighted, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Butunni ikkita teng bo'lakka bo'lsak, har bir bo'lak — yarim 🌓. Ikki yarim birga — yana butun! Olmaning yarmi, nonning yarmi, kvadratning yarmi.

items.image_prompt: A whole shiny red apple, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Butun — hali bo'linmagan narsa: butun olma 🍎, butun non 🍞. Butunni bo'lsak — bo'laklar paydo bo'ladi. Bo'laklarni birlashtirsak — yana butun bo'ladi.

tests.q: Olmani ikki do'stga adolatli qanday bo'lamiz? 🍎
Pechenye ikki teng bo'lakka bo'lindi. Bir bo'lagi nima deyiladi? 🍪

extra.matn: Kvadrat qog'oz ol. Uni o'rtasidan bukib, qirq — ikkita to'g'ri to'rtburchak! Ustma-ust qo'y — teng. Boshqa qog'ozni burchakdan-burchakka bukla — ikkita uchburchak chiqdi! Ular ham teng yarim.

lessons.name: Chorak
lessons.goal: Bola butunni to'rtta teng bo'lakka bo'ladi, chorak tushunchasini biladi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Tug'ilgan kunga to'rtta do'st keldi, tort esa bitta! Yarimga bo'lsak — faqat ikki kishiga yetadi. To'rtta do'stga qanday bo'lamiz? Chorak bizga yordam beradi!

items.image_prompt: A round pizza cut into four equal slices, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Butunni to'rtta teng bo'lakka bo'lsak, har bir bo'lak — chorak 🍕. Tortni avval yarimga, keyin har yarmini yana yarimga kesamiz — to'rtta chorak! Har bir do'stga bittadan.

items.image_prompt: Four slices of cake put back together into a whole round cake, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: To'rtta chorakni birlashtirsak — yana butun tort 🎂. Ikki chorak birga — yarim bo'ladi! Chorak yarimdan kichik, chunki butun ko'proq bo'lakka bo'lingan.

tests.q: Pitsa 4 ta teng bo'lakka kesildi. Bir bo'lagi nima? 🍕
Qaysi bo'lak katta: yarim yoki chorak?

extra.matn: Qog'ozdan doira qirq — bu tort! Uni yarimga bukib, yana yarimga bukla va qirq. Nechta bo'lak chiqdi? To'rtta chorak! Endi o'yinchoqlaringga bittadan ber: ayiqchaga, quyonchaga, qo'g'irchoqqa va o'zingga. Hammaga teng!

lessons.name: Soat bilan tanishamiz
lessons.goal: Bola soat siferblati, kichik va katta millarni taniydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Tik-tak, tik-tak! Bu nima ovoz? Devordagi soat! U bizga qachon turish, qachon ovqatlanish, qachon uxlashni aytadi. Qani, uning tilini o'rganamiz!

items.image_prompt: A round wall clock with numbers one to twelve, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Siferblat — soatning dumaloq yuzi. Unda 1 dan 12 gacha sonlar aylana bo'ylab yozilgan 🕰️. Eng tepada — 12, pastda — 6. Millar shu sonlarni ko'rsatib aylanadi.

items.image_prompt: A clock with a short thick red hour hand highlighted, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kichik mil — qisqa va yo'g'on. U sekin yuradi va soatni ko'rsatadi. Kichik mil 3 ni ko'rsatsa — soat uch! Uni «soat mili» deymiz.

items.image_prompt: A clock with a long thin blue minute hand pointing to twelve, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Katta mil — uzun va ingichka. U tezroq yuradi. Katta mil 12 da tursa — soat butun, ya'ni «roppa-rosa». Ikki qo'lingni cho'z: biri qisqa, biri uzun — mana soat!

tests.q: Soatning son yozilgan yuzi nima deyiladi? 🕰️
Siferblatning eng tepasida qaysi son turadi?

lessons.name: Butun soatlar
lessons.goal: Bola butun soatlarni aniqlaydi (katta mil 12 da)
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! robot Kabuning kuni: soat 7 da uyg'onadi, soat 8 da bog'chaga uchadi, soat 1 da tushlik qiladi. Bu vaqtlarni soatda qanday ko'ramiz? Sir oddiy!

items.image_prompt: A clock showing exactly twelve o'clock, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Butun soatni bilish uchun avval katta milga qaraymiz: u 12 da turibdimi? Ha! Demak, soat roppa-rosa. Endi kichik milga qaraymiz — u qaysi sonni ko'rsatsa, soat shu!

items.uz: kichik mil 3 da, katta mil 12 da
items.image_prompt: A clock showing three o'clock with kids having afternoon snack, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Katta mil 12 da, kichik mil 3 da — soat uch 🕒. Bu tushdan keyingi vaqt: bog'chada uyqudan turib, choy ichamiz.

items.uz: kichik mil 8 da, katta mil 12 da
items.image_prompt: A clock showing eight o'clock with a child walking to kindergarten, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Katta mil 12 da, kichik mil 8 da — soat sakkiz 🕗. Ertalab soat sakkizda bog'chaga yoki maktabga boramiz. Kechqurun soat sakkizda esa uxlashga tayyorlanamiz.

tests.q: 🕒 Katta mil 12 da, kichik mil 3 da. Soat nechchi?

tests.why: Barakalla! Katta mil 12 da tursa — roppa-rosa.

tests.q: Soat 5 bo'lsa, kichik mil qaysi sonni ko'rsatadi?

extra.matn: Qog'oz likopchaga 1 dan 12 gacha sonlarni yoz. Kartondan qisqa va uzun mil qirqib, o'rtasiga igna bilan mahkamla. Endi men aytaman, sen ko'rsatasan: soat 7! Soat 2! Soat 12! Ertalab qachon turasan — o'sha vaqtni ko'rsat!

lessons.name: Yil oylari: qish va bahor
lessons.goal: Bola yilda 12 oy borligini, qish va bahor oylarini biladi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Esingdami, fasllar to'rtta: qish, bahor, yoz, kuz. Har bir fasl ichida uchta oy yashaydi! To'rt fasl, har birida uch oy — jami nechta oy? Qani, bilamiz!

items.image_prompt: A big calendar with twelve small colorful month pages, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yil — bu o'n ikki oy. Har faslda uchtadan oy bor: to'rt fasl — o'n ikki oy. Yil yanvardan boshlanib, dekabrda tugaydi. Keyin yangi yil keladi 🎄!

items.image_prompt: Three snowy calendar pages with snowflakes and a Christmas tree, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qish oylari: dekabr, yanvar, fevral ❄️. Dekabr oxirida Yangi yil bayrami! Yanvar — yilning birinchi oyi. Fevral — qishning oxirgi oyi.

items.image_prompt: Three calendar pages with tulips, swallows and green trees, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bahor oylari: mart, aprel, may 🌷. Martda Navro'z va Onalar bayrami! Aprelda daraxtlar gullaydi, mayda esa hamma yoq yam-yashil.

extra.matn: Aylana bo'lib turamiz va yurib kuylaymiz: «Dekabr, yanvar, fevral — qor yog'ar, bolalar qordon yasar! Mart, aprel, may — gul ochilar, qushlar qaytib kelar!» Har oy nomida bir qadam yur!
extra.doska:
❄️ dekabr yanvar fevral
🌷 mart aprel may

lessons.name: Yoz, kuz oylari va kalendar
lessons.goal: Bola yoz va kuz oylarini biladi, kalendardan kun va oyni topadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Yana ikki fasl qoldi — yoz va kuz. Ularning oylari kim? Va eng muhimi: sen maktabga qaysi oyda borasan? Kalendarga qarab topamiz!

items.image_prompt: Three sunny calendar pages with beach, watermelon and ice cream, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Yoz oylari: iyun, iyul, avgust ☀️. Iyunda bolalar bayrami — 1-iyun! Iyul — eng issiq oy. Avgustda tarvuz va qovun mazali bo'ladi 🍉.

items.image_prompt: Three calendar pages with a school bag, yellow leaves and rain, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kuz oylari: sentabr, oktabr, noyabr 🍂. 1-sentabr — Bilimlar kuni, bolalar maktabga boradi 🎒! Oktabrda barglar sarg'ayadi, noyabrda sovuq boshlanadi.

items.image_prompt: A wall calendar page with a circled date, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Kalendar — yilning hamma kunlari yozilgan jadval 📅. Unda oy nomi, hafta kunlari va sanalar bor. Tug'ilgan kuningni kalendarda doiraga ol — kunlarni sanab kutasan!

tests.q: Kunlar va oylar yozilgan jadval nima? 📅

lessons.name: Katak daftar
lessons.goal: Bola katakni taniydi, katakda yo'nalishlarni (yuqori, past, o'ng, chap) ko'rsatadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Maktabda senga katak daftar beriladi. Undagi kichkina kvadratchalar — kataklar. Ular — matematikaning uychalari! Bugun kataklar bo'ylab sayohat qilamiz.

items.image_prompt: An open squared math notebook with a pencil, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Katak — daftardagi kichkina kvadratcha 🔲. Har bir katakda bitta raqam yashaydi. Kataklarni sanab, qalamni to'g'ri joyga qo'yamiz. Maktabda raqamlarni katakka chiroyli yozamiz!

items.image_prompt: A pencil on grid paper with four arrows up down left right, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qalam katakning chizig'i bo'ylab yuradi. «2 katak o'ngga» — qalamni o'ng tomonga ikki katak yurgizamiz ➡️. «1 katak yuqoriga» — tepaga bitta ⬆️. Esingdami, strelkalar yo'li!

items.image_prompt: A child sitting at a desk with a notebook, left and right hands marked, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Daftarning chap tomonida hoshiya — bo'sh joy, biz o'ng tomonga qarab yozamiz. Qalamni o'ng qo'lda (ba'zilar chapda) ushlaymiz. O'ng — ➡️, chap — ⬅️, esingdami?

lessons.name: Katakda naqsh
lessons.goal: Bola grafik diktant bo'yicha chizadi va katakdagi naqshni davom ettiradi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Men sehrli diktant o'ylab topdim: men faqat strelka va son aytaman, sen chizasan — oxirida rasm paydo bo'ladi! Nima chiqar ekan? Qalamni tayyorla!

items.image_prompt: Grid paper with a stair-step line drawn following arrows, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Grafik diktantda men aytaman: «1 ➡️, 1 ⬆️, 1 ➡️, 1 ⬆️». Sen har buyruqda qalamni yurgizasan. Qara — zinapoya chiqdi 🪜! Diqqat bilan eshitish va sanash kerak.

items.image_prompt: A zigzag pattern and a row of small squares drawn on grid paper, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Naqsh — takrorlanadigan rasm. «2 ⬆️, 2 ➡️, 2 ⬇️, 2 ➡️» — va yana boshidan! Tishli devor chiqadi 🏰. Qoidani topsak, naqshni daftar oxirigacha davom ettiramiz. Esingdami, mantiqiy qatorlar?

tests.why: Barakalla! Qoida: yuqori, o'ng, past, o'ng.

extra.matn: Katak daftarda nuqta qo'y. Diqqat, men aytaman: 3 katak o'ngga ➡️. 3 katak pastga ⬇️. 3 katak chapga ⬅️. 3 katak yuqoriga ⬆️. Nima chiqdi? Kvadrat! Uning ichiga kulib turgan yuz chizing 🙂.

lessons.name: So'm tangalari
lessons.goal: Bola so'm tangalarini (100, 200, 500 so'm) taniydi, bir xil tangalarni sanaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Men do'konga bormoqchiman, cho'ntagimda tangalar jiringlayapti. Lekin qaysi tanga qancha turadi? O'zbekiston pullari — so'm! Qani, tanishamiz.

items.image_prompt: A few shiny round Uzbek-style coins on a table, no text, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Tanga — dumaloq metall pul 🪙. Har bir tangada son yozilgan — u qancha turishini bildiradi. Bizning pulimiz — so'm. Tangani og'izga solma, o'ynagach qo'lni yuv!

items.image_prompt: A single silver coin labeled with a big number one hundred, simple, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Bu — yuz so'mlik tanga. Unda 1 va ikki nol yozilgan: 100. Ikkita yuzlik — ikki yuz so'm, uchta yuzlik — uch yuz so'm! Sanaymiz: yuz, ikki yuz, uch yuz.

items.image_prompt: Two coins with numbers two hundred and five hundred, simple cartoon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Ikki yuz so'mlik tanga — ikkita yuzlikka teng. Besh yuz so'mlik tanga — beshta yuzlikka teng! Tangalar almashtiriladi: bitta ikki yuzlik = ikkita yuzlik.

tests.why: Ofarin! Yuz, ikki yuz, uch yuz.

tests.q: Bitta ikki yuzlik nechta yuzlikka teng?

lessons.name: Do'kon o'yini
lessons.goal: Bola yuzlik tangalar bilan narx to'laydi va qoldiqni 10 ichida hisoblaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Bugun biz do'kon ochamiz! Men sotuvchiman, sen xaridor. Hamma narsaning narxi yuzlik tangalarda. Hisob to'g'ri bo'lsa — xarid seniki!

items.image_prompt: A toy shop shelf with price tags showing coin pictures, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Narx — narsa qancha turishi 🏷️. Bizning do'konda: olma — 2 ta yuzlik, shar — 3 ta yuzlik, kitob — 5 ta yuzlik. Narxni tangalar soni bilan sanaymiz.

items.image_prompt: A child handing coins to a shopkeeper pigeon, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Shar 3 ta yuzlik turadi. Sotuvchiga tangalarni bittadan sanab beramiz: bir, ikki, uch 🪙🪙🪙. Olma va shar birga qancha? 2 + 3 = 5 ta yuzlik!

items.image_prompt: A small purse with a few coins left inside, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Hamyonda 7 ta yuzlik bor edi. Kitobga 5 tasini to'ladik. Nechta qoldi? 7 − 5 = 2 ta yuzlik 👛. Qoldiqni hisoblash — ayirish!

tests.q: Olma 🍎 — 2 yuzlik, shar 🎈 — 3 yuzlik. Birga nechta yuzlik?
Hamyonda 7 yuzlik, 5 tasini to'ladik. Nechta qoldi? 👛
Senda 4 yuzlik bor. Kitob 5 yuzlik. Yetadimi? 📕

extra.matn: Uydagi o'yinchoqlarga narx qo'y: 1 dan 5 gacha yuzlik. Tugma yoki qog'oz doirachalar — tangalar bo'lsin. Har kim 10 ta tanga oladi. Xarid qil va har safar hisobla: nechta to'lading, nechta qoldi? Oxirida kimda ko'p tanga qoldi?

lessons.name: Sabab va oqibat
lessons.goal: Bola voqealar orasidagi sabab-oqibat bog'lanishini topadi va tartiblaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Kecha yomg'ir yog'di — bugun ko'chada ko'lmaklar! Nega shunday? Har bir voqeaning sababi bor. Bugun biz izquvar bo'lib, «nega?» savoliga javob qidiramiz.

items.image_prompt: Dark clouds with rain falling on a street, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sabab — biror narsa nima uchun bo'lganini bildiradi. Yomg'ir yog'di 🌧️ — bu sabab. Sababni topish uchun «Nega?» deb so'raymiz.

items.image_prompt: Children in rubber boots jumping in puddles after rain, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Oqibat — sababdan keyin nima bo'lganligi. Yomg'ir yog'di — oqibati: ko'lmaklar paydo bo'ldi 💧. Qor yog'di — oqibati: qordon yasadik. Muzqaymoq quyoshda qoldi — eridi! 🍦

items.image_prompt: Three pictures: a seed, a sprout, a flower, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Voqealar tartib bilan bo'ladi: avval urug' ekamiz 🌰, keyin suv quyamiz 💧, oxirida gul o'sadi 🌷. Tartibni aralashtirib bo'lmaydi — gul urug'dan oldin o'smaydi!

tests.q: Muzqaymoq quyoshda uzoq qoldi 🍦☀️. Nima bo'ladi?
Stakan stoldan yerga tushdi 🥛. Oqibat nima?
tests.why: Zo'r! Stakan sinishi yoki suv to'kilishi mumkin.

extra.matn: Ikki bo'lak muz ol. Birini derazaning quyosh tushadigan joyiga, ikkinchisini soyaga qo'y. Soatga qara va bir soatdan keyin tekshir. Qaysi biri tezroq eridi? Nega? Sabab — quyosh issig'i, oqibat — muz erishi!

lessons.name: Qonuniyatni top
lessons.goal: Bola sonlar va rasmlar qatoridagi qonuniyatni topadi, ikkitalab sanaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Mening sehrli zinapoyam bor, lekin men har gal bitta emas, ikki pog'onadan sakrab chiqaman! Qaysi pog'onalarga qo'nishimni topa olasanmi? Bu — qonuniyat!

items.image_prompt: A row of shapes circle square circle square with a magnifier, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qonuniyat — qatorda takrorlanib turuvchi qoida. 🔺🟥🟥🔺🟥🟥 — qoida: bitta uchburchak, ikkita kvadrat. Qoidani topsak, istalgan joyni bilamiz!

items.image_prompt: Pairs of shoes in a row, each pair counted, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Oyoq kiyimlar juft-juft turadi 👟👟. Juftlab sanaymiz: ikki, to'rt, olti, sakkiz, o'n! Har safar ikkitaga ko'payadi. Bu tezroq sanash usuli!
items.action: Har juftda ikki marta qarsak chal!

items.image_prompt: Towers of cubes growing one, two, three, four tall, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Qator o'sib borishi ham mumkin: 🟦, 🟦🟦, 🟦🟦🟦 ... har gal bittaga ko'p. Keyingisi — to'rtta kub! Sonlar bilan: 1, 3, 5, 7 — har gal ikkitaga ko'payadi, keyingisi 9.

tests.why: Ofarin! Har gal ikkitaga ko'p — to'qqiz.
Zo'r! Har gal ikkitaga kam — to'rt.

extra.matn: Yerga 0 dan 10 gacha qog'oz sonlar qo'y. Nolda tur. Endi har gal bittasini tashlab, ikkitalab sakra va ayt: ikki, to'rt, olti, sakkiz, o'n! Endi orqaga: o'n, sakkiz, olti, to'rt, ikki, nol! Barakalla, kenguru!

lessons.name: Tartib sonlar
lessons.goal: Bola tartib sonlarini (birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi, oxirgi) ishlatadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Bog'chada yugurish musobaqasi bo'ldi! Quyoncha, toshbaqa va tulki qatnashdi. Kim birinchi keldi, kim ikkinchi, kim oxirgi? Tartibni aytishni o'rganamiz!

items.image_prompt: A bunny crossing the finish line first with a gold medal, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Birinchi — navbatda eng oldinda turgan 🥇. Musobaqada birinchi kelgan g'olib bo'ladi. Qatorda birinchi turgan bola eshikka eng yaqin.

items.image_prompt: A fox with a silver medal and a cat with a bronze medal, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Birinchidan keyin — ikkinchi 🥈, undan keyin — uchinchi 🥉. Tartib sonlar oddiy sonlardan yasaladi: ikki — ikkinchi, uch — uchinchi, besh — beshinchi!

items.image_prompt: A slow smiling turtle reaching the finish line last, happy anyway, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Oxirgi — navbatda eng orqada turgan 🐢. Toshbaqa oxirgi keldi, lekin u taslim bo'lmadi — marragacha yetdi! Qatorda oxirgi turgandan keyin hech kim yo'q.

tests.q: Navbatda sen oxirgisan 🐢. Orqangda nechta bola bor?
tests.why: Zo'r! Oxirgidan keyin hech kim yo'q.

extra.matn: Oilang bilan saf tort — poyezd bo'l! Sen eng oldinda — birinchi vagon. «Ikkinchi vagon, qo'l ko'tar!», «Uchinchi vagon, sakra!», «Oxirgi vagon, chuh-chuh de!» Keyin joylaringni almashtir va yana o'yna!

lessons.name: Maktabga tayyormiz!
lessons.goal: Bola 20 gacha sanaydi, 10 ichida qo'shadi-ayiradi va masala yechadi — maktabga tayyor
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Do'stim, sen juda ko'p narsa o'rganding! Yaqinda maktab eshigi ochiladi. Oxirgi sinov: sanoq, hisob va masala. Tayyormisan? Men senga ishonaman!

items.image_prompt: A proud child with a star badge standing in front of numbers one to twenty, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sanoq ustasi yigirmagacha oldinga va orqaga adashmay sanaydi, har bir sonning qo'shnisini biladi. 15 ning qo'shnilari — 14 va 16. Sen ham ustasan!

items.image_prompt: A child at a desk solving simple sums with a big smile, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Hisob ustasi o'n ichida tez qo'shadi va ayiradi: katta sondan sanab ketadi, o'nning do'stlarini eslaydi. 6 + 4 = 10, 10 − 4 = 6. Qo'shish va ayirish — aka-uka!

items.image_prompt: A colorful school backpack with a notebook, pencils and a ruler, cute cartoon, soft flat colors, white background, no text, square
items.explain: Sumkamizda katak daftar, qalam va chizg'ich 🎒. Biz sanaymiz, hisoblaymiz, masala yechamiz, soatni bilamiz. Endi maktabga dadil qadam! Bip-bip!, sendan faxrlanaman!

tests.why: To'g'ri! O'n to'rt va o'n olti.

tests.q: Savatda 9 ta olxo'ri bor edi. 4 tasini yedik. Nechta qoldi?
🕘 Katta mil 12 da, kichik mil 9 da. Soat nechchi?

extra.matn: «Yigirmagacha sanayman, plyus-minusni bilaman, soatga qarab turaman, masalani yechaman — men maktabga boraman!» Qo'shiqni kuylab, sumkani yelkaga olib, xonada g'olibdek yur! Bip-bip!, barakalla!
